title: Looting at Eridu and the campaign to save it

tellings.quote: I end up finding all these photographs over the last 10 years of locals going in and just pillaging pillaging the site

plain: A guest named Matt, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about Eridu, an ancient city site in Iraq. He says he found many photographs from the last ten years showing locals going into the site and plundering it, and that this pushed a campaign to save it. He tells it because, as he sees it, the site's history could be lost before anyone studies it.
